title: lookup_article_by_msgid uses 500 for internal errors — should be 503
description: In lifecycle.rs lookup_article_by_msgid, storage errors return Response::new(500, "Internal error: storage lookup failed"). RFC 3977 §3.3 defines 500 as 'Unknown command' and 503 as 'Program fault / internal error'. Using 500 for internal errors sends the wrong semantic signal — a client seeing 500 may retry the command thinking it sent something malformed. What would make it clear: use Response::program_fault() (code 503) for these storage error paths.
